concepts.description: Defining and dispatching the hivemind_* MCP tools: HIVEMIND_TOOL_DEFS, executeToolByName, createMcpServer, the tool-def + executeX pattern, the 11-tool table and auto-approval
Serving the tools: stdio server (bun run mcp, hivemind-mcp) and the streamable-HTTP server startHttpMcpServer (PORT, bearer HIVEMIND_API_TOKEN, /health, one transport per mcp-session-id)
The Claude Code SessionStart hook runSessionStartHook: stdin JSON, project from git repo name, local register+status or remote via HIVEMIND_REMOTE_URL, CLAUDE_AGENT_LABEL, context output
Setting hivemind up in Claude Code: install (claude mcp add, permissions), init (DB, SessionStart hooks in .claude/settings.json, generated .claude/CLAUDE.md from the Hivemind Events section)
The hivemind CLI commands (commander, src/cli.ts): status, join, watch and the command wiring
Bun-only runtime (bun:sqlite, no Node, no better-sqlite3) and the dev checks bun test src/ and tsc
Agent records: registerAgent, reconnect by session id then PID, getAgent*, updateAgent*, hivemind_register and hivemind_status
Deciding an agent is alive or dead: local PID mode vs network lease mode (isNetworkLivenessMode, getAgentLeaseTtlMs, last_seen_at, touchAgent), markAgentDead releasing tasks
The per-project detached coordinator: ensureCoordinator from hivemind_emit, pid/lock files, runCoordinator 30 s sweep emitting agent:dead, hosting the plan watcher
The shared event log: emit, getEventsSince/By*, getRecentEvents, hivemind_emit/query/events, event types actually emitted, how agents should post events
Plan files into plans and tasks: startPlanWatcher, syncPlanFile, initialPlanSync, regex extractTasksFromPlan, reconcileTasks, plan records
Task records and states (pending, claimed, in_progress, blocked, done): createTask, claim/start/complete tools, blockTask/unclaimTask/assignTask helpers
execSync git wrappers: isGitRepo, getRepoName, getBranch, getRepoRoot, getGitInfo, getWorktrees, getCurrentWorktree
The worktree registry: register/lookup worktrees, syncWorktreesFromGit, hivemind_worktree_cleanup and worktree:stale
Per-project SQLite: getConnection (cached WAL bun:sqlite), schema.sql and migration, HIVEMIND_BASE data dir, sequences, hivemind_setup and hivemind_reset
Hivemind ids {prefix}_{6hex}[_{label}] for agt/pln/tsk/evt/wkt: makeXId, sanitizeLabel, parseId, typed ids
Local yyyy/mm/dd hh:mm:ss TZ timestamps: now, formatDatetime, parseDatetime, isStale
